name: flow-whatsapp-ask-connected
label: Send it from your phone
description: The phone sends its code; the hub validates it. The step finishes by itself once the phone is connected.

exe_data.detail:
**1. Open WhatsApp** — [tap here]({{connect.link}}) on your phone, or scan:

![Scan with your phone]({{connect.qr}})

**2. Send the code** `{{connect.code}}` — it is already typed in the message.

**3. Status:** waiting for your message…
